output.title: Adding and removing team members
output.content: Admins can add or remove team members from Account Settings > Team. Removing a member immediately revokes their access; there is no confirmation delay. Each member's role (Admin, Editor, Viewer) can be changed from the same screen.

output.title: Changing your billing email address
output.content: To change the email address that receives invoices, go to Account Settings > Billing > Billing Contact and update the email field. This does not change your login email.

output.title: Two-factor authentication setup
output.content: Enable two-factor authentication from Account Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Authy) and enter the 6-digit code to confirm setup. Save the backup codes shown at the end in a safe place.

**Re: How do I add a new team member?**

Thanks for reaching out! Adding a team member is straightforward:

1. Go to **Account Settings > Team**
2. From there, admins can add new team members to the workspace

When you add someone, you'll also be able to assign their role—choosing from Admin, Editor, or Viewer. You can change roles at any time from that same screen.

If you have any questions during the process or need help, feel free to reach out!
